title: tooling: the generated ADR index drops underscores from titles (sys_metadata shows as sysmetadata)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Found while drafting #35339's ADR (PR #35370). Filed by area data-2 at the seat's request.

## What happens
`scripts/adr-index.mjs#plainText` strips `*`, `_` and `>` from each ADR title (`.replace(/[*_>]/g, '')`) before it writes the generated `docs/adr/README.md` index. An identifier with an underscore loses it, so the index names things that do not exist.

On `main` today the index shows `sysmetadata` (ADR-0005), `statemachine` (ADR-0020), `syspermissionset` (ADR-0094) and `SCREAMINGSNAKE` (ADR-0112) for titles that read `sys_metadata`, `state_machine`, `sys_permission_set` and `SCREAMING_SNAKE`. A first regeneration of PR #35370 rendered `sys_unit` as `sysunit`; that ADR's title now avoids the identifier.

Check: `grep -n '\[ADR-0005\]' docs/adr/README.md`.

## Done when
Underscores inside identifiers survive into the index (strip only Markdown emphasis markers, e.g. a `_` that opens or closes emphasis, or keep code spans verbatim), the index is regenerated, and a pin covers one underscore identifier and one emphasised word.

## Grade
p3 · tooling. Internal docs index only; no product surface. Rides a same-file p2 PR (`scripts/adr-index.mjs` or the generated index); not dispatched alone.
